scope: chat:what changed in the june 18 notice?

gemini.value:
The emergency program area became the entirety of the Mexican fruit fly quarantine area within San Diego County, which became effective on June 18, 2026 [cdfa_pep_sv_amd2#003]. This was done because the life cycle of the Mexflies detected between June 4, 2026 and June 12, 2026 had not yet transpired, creating a high potential for sudden future detections in Spring Valley, El Cajon, and surrounding communities [cdfa_pep_sv_amd2#003]. We cannot claim legal certainty; please confirm details with CDFA, the San Diego County Agricultural Commissioner, or USDA APHIS.
